about_the_game:
You’re a night-shift nurse, called out for an urgent house visit to help a deaf patient who’s had a serious fall while working on his attic. You are the only person in the organization that knows sign language, so you're called out to this job during the hours. At first, everything seems routine. But as the night goes colder, things quickly take a dark turn. strange noises from empty rooms, claw marks along the walls and A sense of dread when you believe someone or something watching you.

Shortly before midnight, your patient vanishes leaving only a trail. You’re not alone, and something is watching your every move.

In Watcher from the Void, a tense, strategy-based horror experience, you’ll need to fine 10 key cards to unlock the attic and escape. But be careful it roams the halls, hunting you as you search.

Find alternate routes through vents and behind locked doors as you try to avoid the creature’s path, each step pulling you deeper into the shadows of the house.

Key Features:

- Strategy: with limited resources and a single route strategies the main key to win.

- Distraction Mechanic: by tossing a coin you can distract it at any time, but use them wisely.

- Alternative Pathways: Crawl through vents or unlock doors, but be warned not all doors it should be opened.

This game is not for the weak, I challenge you to Beat It, the question is will you.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 / SteamOS 3.0 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7850 (Driver: Mesa 20.0+ or NVIDIA 450+)
  • Storage: 7 MB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL-compatible or PulseAudio-compatible sound device

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 (High Sierra) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 / Apple M1 or better
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Pro 560 / Intel UHD 630 or better
  • Storage: 7 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any macOS-compatible sound device
